lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a repeating grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits. These clusters form approximately five distinct horizontal rows visible along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at regular intervals, with high-intensity blobs functioning as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of a high-intensity top edge and a low-intensity shadowed region immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, primarily localized toward the anterior margin and the lower half of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance, elongated trailing object with a bifurcated or fanned distal end is visible attached to the ventral region, posterior to the pectoral fin.
